# GitHub collaboration

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.yml](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.yml) | Propose a capability |
| [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/design.yml](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/design.yml) | Design study |
| [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml) | Defect report |
| [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/test.yml](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/test.yml) | Verification activity |
| [PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) | Cross-team review checklist |

Issues in use: #6 (T05 chassis), #11 (T01 size), #12 (T02 motors), #21 (T17 battery), #29 (T18
vision). Branch naming and review rules: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). No automation or branch
protection is configured.
